# PDF.js 6.4.299

Unmodified legacy minified browser build and worker from the official pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 npm distribution. Apache-2.0 license is included in LICENSE. Legacy build is used for broader Safari compatibility; physical iPhone verification is still required.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz
Verified distribution SHA-512 (base64): AVl138zALtfaAPvADulE0PZThbYzCBS79nL4pOSL/6Sm/4AH5A21BD9VHt97OlCuzJuCpmeZtAtkinisF4Vb1g==

Only PDF pixels are rendered for QR decoding. The application supplies local file bytes, never a PDF URL. It does not execute document actions or import text, annotations, forms or links as routes. Both library and worker are served by Drivers Lounge. Missing font/image resources and rendering failures require original review or a clear QR photo; scan completion is not permit completeness.
